title: Birthdays
intro: Everyone's birthday on the server (day and month). Ring the bell and the bot sends you a DM the day before and on the day.
empty: Nobody has added their birthday yet.
loginText: Log in to add your birthday and get reminders.
reminderHint: Reminders come as a DM from the bot. Your DMs from server members need to be open.

mine.title: My birthday
mine.saved: Saved. The bot's /birthday knows it too.
mine.private: Others see the day and month on the list and your profile (if they may see your profile). The year only helps the bot count your age.
mine.locked: You can change it again on {{date}}. Made a mistake? Ask <contact>MrKoby07</contact> to fix it.
mine.moved: Someone else celebrates on your birthday already (they added theirs first), so your celebration on the site is on {{date}}. The bot still wishes you on your actual birthday.
mine.pickDate: Pick a month and a day.
mine.lockWarning: Saving locks the date for 6 months.

dress.title: My birthday dress code
dress.text: Today is your day: pick what everyone (and the lobby cat) wears. It shows on the cult page until midnight; next year you pick a new one.
dress.later: On your celebration day ({{date}}) you pick your birthday dress code here, a new one every year. It shows on the cult page and the lobby cat wears it all day.
dress.laterNoDate: On your celebration day you pick your birthday dress code here, a new one every year.

cat.you: Happy birthday!! 🎂 Today is all about you.
cat.other: It's {{name}}'s birthday today! 🎂 Say happy birthday!

openDiscord: Open their user card on Discord
